verdict.rationale: Built-in operational AI is a fair question for a banking-infrastructure platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no AI capability: no natural-language transaction search, no drafted dispute or alert responses, and no anomaly summaries. The Unit Dashboard and APIs only provide access to operational data, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, the product ships its own AI for banking operations — natural-language search over transactions, drafted responses to disputes and alerts, anomaly summaries — built in, not bolted on
